source_name: Ofsted childcare providers and inspections - open data
what_it_contains: Monthly management-information CSV/XLSX of every registered childcare provider in England (URN, provider name, address, postcode, registration type, places, inspection outcome, provider organisation/group name where linked).
how_to_extract: Download the latest 'Childcare providers and inspections' spreadsheet; filter Provider type = Childcare on non-domestic premises; group by 'Organisation' / 'Provider group' column to identify chains; join to Companies House by organisation name.

source_name: Ofsted 'Find an inspection report' provider search
what_it_contains: Per-provider pages listing all settings owned by the same organisation (e.g. /provider/49/2645864), inspection reports, contact details.
how_to_extract: Search organisation name; scrape provider ID page for list of registered settings; reports contain manager and nominated individual names.

what_it_contains: CSV of all registered care services in Scotland including Day Care of Children (nurseries), with service provider name, address, capacity, grades and provider type.
how_to_extract: Download monthly datastore CSV; filter CareService = 'Day Care of Children'; group by ServiceProvider to find groups (e.g. Thrive, Busy Bees, Bright Horizons).

source_name: Care Inspectorate Wales (CIW) service directory / open data
what_it_contains: Register of childcare and play services in Wales (full day care), with provider (responsible individual) and setting details.
how_to_extract: Use the directory search filtered to 'Full Day Care'; CIW also publishes an annual list of registered services as an Excel file on request / in the Chief Inspector's report data annex.

source_name: NI Family Support / HSC Trust early years registers
what_it_contains: Searchable register of day nurseries registered with the five HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland.
how_to_extract: Search by service type 'Day Nursery' per council area; export listing pages.

source_name: Tusla Register of Early Years Services
what_it_contains: Downloadable Excel/CSV register of every registered early-years service in Ireland: service name, registered provider (company), address, county, service type (full day, sessional), max children, registration date; plus inspection reports.
how_to_extract: Download the county-level or national register file; group by 'Registered Provider' to identify chains (Giraffe, Tigers, Links, Cocoon etc.); link to CRO company numbers.

source_name: Pobal Early Years Sector Profile & Hive service list
what_it_contains: Annual sector profile with service counts, capacity and Core Funding participants; Pobal 'Hive' lists services contracted for ECCE/NCS.
how_to_extract: Use the annual profile PDF/Excel for market sizing; request service-level data via the NCS/ECCE service finder at https://www.ncs.gov.ie.

source_name: Companies House - advanced search by SIC 88910 (child day-care activities)
what_it_contains: All UK companies with SIC 88910, officers (directors), PSCs (owners), accounts (turnover, employee counts), registered office.
how_to_extract: Advanced search with SIC 88910 and status Active, export via the Companies House REST API (https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk/) or the free bulk 'BasicCompanyData' CSV filtered to SICCode 88910; pull officers endpoint for decision makers.

source_name: Companies Registration Office (CRO) / Solr open data
what_it_contains: Irish company register with directors and filings for creche operators (NACE 88.91).
how_to_extract: Use CORE search or the CRO open-data API (https://services.cro.ie/) to find companies matching Tusla provider names; pull directors.

source_name: daynurseries.co.uk - Top 20 Nursery Groups and group directory
what_it_contains: Group pages listing every setting per group (searchgroup IDs), reviews, fees, manager names; annual Top 20 large/mid-size nursery group awards.
how_to_extract: Scrape group search-results pages (day_nursery_search_results.cfm/searchgroup/<id>) for setting lists; use the awards page for a curated group list each year.

source_name: Nursery World - Nursery Groups Report / Nursery Chains league tables (annual, Feb)
what_it_contains: Top 25 UK groups by settings/places, Ofsted quality ranking, ownership and CEO interviews ('People & places').
how_to_extract: Subscription required for full tables; headline figures are in free news summaries. Extract the table annually and append to a master list.

what_it_contains: Paid market report with operator rankings, revenues, M&A, investor backing for the top ~50 groups.
how_to_extract: Purchase report; use the operator league table and M&A appendix to enrich ownership fields.

source_name: Christie & Co / Savills day-nursery market reviews
what_it_contains: Free annual market reviews with transaction lists (buyer/seller/site counts) and sector KPIs.
how_to_extract: Download PDFs; mine the transaction tables for acquisitive groups and newly formed platforms.

what_it_contains: DfE register of schools including maintained nursery schools, independent schools with nursery/pre-prep provision, and their head teachers and trusts.
how_to_extract: Use 'Download' > establishment CSV; filter PhaseOfEducation = Nursery or TypeOfEstablishment contains 'Independent' with StatutoryLowAge <= 3; join by trust/ proprietor.

source_name: NDNA (National Day Nurseries Association) member directory & awards
what_it_contains: Membership body (chair: Sarah Steel OBE); annual awards listing top settings and groups; policy contacts.
how_to_extract: Awards shortlists and member spotlights give confirmed manager/owner names; use for independent-nursery leads.

what_it_contains: Profiles of childcare franchisors (Banana Moon, Monkey Puzzle, etc.) with contacts and network size.
how_to_extract: Filter category Childcare/Education; capture franchisor head-office contacts.

source_name: NMT (Nursery Management Today) news & Top 25 rankings
what_it_contains: Trade news on appointments, acquisitions and funding; annual nursery group rankings.
how_to_extract: Monitor 'appointments' and 'acquisitions' tags; free to read.

source_name: Early Childhood Ireland member & 'Childcare Barometer' resources
what_it_contains: National association (c.3,800 member services); policy reports and events for reaching Irish operators.
how_to_extract: Use event sponsorship/exhibitor lists and the annual conference for contacts; not a public register.
